title: RegenHands
tagline: A powerful vault for users to lock funds until the value 3X, 10X or 100X in fiat terms and/or lock funds until a specific block height (1/5/20 years). It's a contract to remove narrative driven speculators’ capacity to sell their tokens too early.
description: This demo locks tokens into a contract until a given block height is reached, in a latter version we  would enable locking the tokens until the value of the token reached a certain value in FIAT (which would unlock the regen part of the project). We deploy a contract for each user.
how_its_made: We use Arbitrum Sepolia, Solidity, and React. The contract asks for token allowance, then we lock the tokens, then the contract is showcasing the proper amount of token locked, once the chain reached the proper height, the tokens can be claimed. In another version of this, the tokens would be locked until a certain value.
